function: The rotate property allows you to rotate elements.

defaults.Animatable: yes. Read about animatable Try it

values.function: Optional. If not set, z-axis is default. Defines axis to rotate element around. Possible values: x y z
Defines how much an element is rotated. Possible units: deg rad turn

Three numbers define a vector for the element to be rotated around. The numbers are x-, y- and z-coordinates for the vector, respectively. The last value is the angle for how much to rotate. Possible values: number number number angle
Sets this property to its default value. Read about initial
Inherits this property from its parent element. Read about inherit
